title: Polarity Peak: Magnetic Stack Challenge
core_loop: A magnetized block oscillates horizontally above the tower. Tap to drop it — but polarity matters. The tower's top layer has a magnetic pole (N or S) that alternates each layer. Dropping a block with matching polarity (N-on-N or S-on-S) causes REPULSION: the block pushes away from center, requiring wider alignment tolerance but granting a polarity bonus. Dropping with OPPOSITE polarity causes ATTRACTION: the block snaps toward center with a tighter 3px perfect window. Stack 15 layers to win — a miss (≤4px overlap) ends the run instantly.
controls: Single tap/click anywhere (or Spacebar) to drop the moving block. No horizontal control — timing and polarity awareness are the only skills. Touch-friendly: entire screen is the drop zone. Polarity of next block shown as N/S indicator beside score.
mechanics: Horizontally oscillating magnetized block (N or S pole) that moves faster each layer (120 -> 280 px/sec)
Alternating tower polarity each layer: base is N, layer 1 is S, layer 2 is N, etc. Block polarity RANDOM each spawn (50/50 N/S)
REPULSION (matching polarity): block resists centering. Perfect tolerance WIDENS to 10px. Overlap calculation uses expanded bounds. Perfect drop grants +50% score bonus and polarity streak counter
ATTRACTION (opposite polarity): block snaps toward center. Perfect tolerance TIGHTENS to 3px. Perfect drop grants +25% score bonus but higher precision required
Overlap calculation: intersecting portion becomes new layer. Repulsion expands effective overlap zone; attraction contracts it
Polarity streak: consecutive drops with same interaction type (repulsion or attraction) build streak multiplier (x1, x1.5, x2, x2.5 max)
Progressive narrowing: each miss or imperfect drop reduces next layer's width. Perfect drops maintain width
Layer descent animation: all existing rows shift down smoothly (180ms cubic-ease) when new layer locks
Offcut physics: sheared pieces fall away with polarity-tinted rotation and fade (repulsion=red shift, attraction=blue shift)
Speed scaling: each layer increases oscillation speed by 6 px/sec up to 280 px/sec cap (slightly slower base than v1 to accommodate polarity reading)
juice: Magnetic field visualization: subtle animated field lines (N=blue outward, S=red inward) around moving block and tower top
Repulsion perfect drop: cyan camera flash (100ms), particle burst (electric blue, 12 particles) with radial push animation, floating 'REPEL PERFECT' text with streak multiplier
Attraction perfect drop: magenta camera flash (100ms), particle burst (magnetic pink, 12 particles) with radial pull animation, floating 'ATTRACT PERFECT' text with streak multiplier
Polarity switch indicator: when block spawns, N/S symbol pulses with field-color glow for 800ms
Camera shake (200ms, 0.012 intensity) on miss with polarity-shock screen distortion
Smooth cubic-ease row descent animation (180ms) when new layer locks in
Offcut fall-away animation with polarity-tinted rotation and fade (600ms, red for repulsion offcuts, blue for attraction)
Polarity streak meter: vertical bar beside score that fills with each same-type perfect, glows at max streak
Pulsing 'TAP TO DROP' prompt with field-line breathing animation during attract mode
Intro banner: 'MATCH POLES TO REPEL • OPPOSE TO ATTRACT • TAP WHEN ALIGNED' auto-dismisses after 3 seconds
6-layer polarity-cycling palette (N-layers: cool blues/cyans, S-layers: warm reds/magentas)
Game-over/win end card with final score, polarity streak record, retry and CTA buttons (via Juice toolkit)
mvp_scope: Single-screen vertical stacking game, 800x450. 15 target layers to win. Base row 260px wide, 28px tall. All graphics are procedural Phaser rectangles with strokes and animated field-line shaders — zero external assets. Oscillating block spawns with random N/S polarity each layer. Tower top polarity alternates deterministically. Repulsion: 10px perfect tolerance, +50% score. Attraction: 3px perfect tolerance, +25% score. Score = 10 per layer + polarity bonus * streak multiplier. LocalStorage high-score + max-streak persistence. Keyboard (Space) and touch/click input. 60fps target on mobile.
win_lose_condition: Win: Stack 15 layers (any width > 0) — triggers victory end card with final score, max polarity streak, and polarity breakdown (repulsion vs attraction perfects). Lose: Moving block has ≤4px overlap with previous layer on tap — instant game over with magnetic shock animation. No partial credit; one miss ends the run. High score and max streak tracked across sessions.
